title: Two Eyes
intro: A group with two separate, secure eyes cannot be captured. The opponent cannot fill both eyes in one move.

steps.instruction: Play in the middle of the three empty points to make two eyes.
steps.hint: The middle of the three. Yes, inside your own shape.
steps.explanation: The group now surrounds two separate empty points. White cannot play in either without self-capture.

steps.instruction: You are White. Capture this black group with only one eye.
steps.hint: The group is touching exactly one empty point. It is inside.
steps.explanation: The eye was Black's last liberty. Capturing Black makes this White move legal.

steps.instruction: You are White. Try placing a stone in either empty eye.
steps.hint: Play in one of the eyes. The game will stop you.
steps.explanation: The move is refused. It captures nothing because Black still has the other eye, and White would have no liberty.

outro: Two secure eyes keep a group alive. Before relying on them, check that the surrounding stones cannot be cut apart.
